title: Genie One enhancements
body:
* **Genie traces in the unified trace table (Beta)**: Genie Code and Genie One turns can now be exported to the Unity Gateway unified trace table as OpenTelemetry spans. A workspace admin turns on tracing for each product from the **Previews** page. By default, only the trace table's owner can query the traces. See [Monitor Genie Code and Genie One with the unified trace table](/aws/en/ai-gateway/genie-traces).
* **Faster responses**: Genie One now responds more quickly when you ask a question.
* **Expand visualizations**: You can now open a visualization from a Genie One response in the side panel, where you can interact with it at a larger size next to the conversation. See [Expand a visualization](/aws/en/genie-one/chat#expand-visualizations).
